summary: The candidates in this set are characterized by a mix of systemic health indicators (e.g., hyperlipidemia, hypertension) and anatomical/laboratory markers (e.g., hematocrit, hemoglobin, hilar lymphadenopathy). Systemic indicators and several laboratory markers show strong evidence for confounding roles, often paired with complementary signals for effect modification from R-learners and causal forests. In contrast, clinical examination signs (HEENT) and specific surgical histories (hernia repair) lack prognostic signal but are identified as effect modifiers by R-learner evidence.
